LanguageData.RatkinQL_LostKitTree_Report: A frantic ratkin parent came to us, looking for a lost child.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_LostKit_Greeting: A ratkin parent bursts through the door, eyes wide. “Please—my little one! We were passing through, and now they’re gone. I don’t know where. Please, {Interviewer_labelShort}, help me find them.”
LanguageData.RatkinQL_LostKit_OptSearch: “I’ll rally some people to help search.”
LanguageData.RatkinQL_LostKit_OptComfort: “Here, have some food and wait with me.” (2 hardtack)
LanguageData.RatkinQL_LostKit_Story1: “We stopped to rest, and she saw a butterfly… chased it into the tall grass and just—vanished.”
LanguageData.RatkinQL_LostKit_Story2: “Something spooked the pack animals—a boomrat, maybe. Everyone scattered, and when I counted heads, he wasn’t there.”
LanguageData.RatkinQL_LostKit_Story3: “I thought he was right behind me the whole time. Must’ve crawled into a bush for a nap. By the time I noticed, we’d already moved on.”
LanguageData.RatkinQL_LostKit_Farewell: The parent clutches their chest and bows deeply. “Thank you—thank you. I won’t forget this.” They hurry away, still trembling.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_LostKit_MsgReunion: With your help, the lost kit was found safe. The parent scoops them up, both crying and laughing at once.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_LostKit_MsgComfort: The parent accepts the food with shaking hands. They take a few bites, shoulders slowly relaxing. “You’re kind. Thank you.”
